units.rawText: I often wonder if I'm living up to Turing's sacrifice.
units.displayText: I often wonder if I'm living up to Turing's sacrifice.

spans.text: I often wonder if I'm living up to Turing's sacrifice.

units.rawText: I'm nothing more than an agent she created, an entity that Magrasea did not allow to exist.
units.displayText: I'm nothing more than an agent she created, an entity that Magrasea did not allow to exist.

spans.text: I'm nothing more than an agent she created, an entity that Magrasea did not allow to exist.

units.rawText: I took over Turing's mission and ran the Rossum Sector, desperately trying to rebuild everything, all because I want to prove that I'm not wasting her contributions.
units.displayText: I took over Turing's mission and ran the Rossum Sector, desperately trying to rebuild everything, all because I want to prove that I'm not wasting her contributions.

spans.text: I took over Turing's mission and ran the Rossum Sector, desperately trying to rebuild everything, all because I want to prove that I'm not wasting her contributions.

units.rawText: But now, I'm starting to understand... She didn't want me to be bound by the past. I want to overcome the past and move forward with Turing as she is now.
units.displayText: But now, I'm starting to understand... She didn't want me to be bound by the past. I want to overcome the past and move forward with Turing as she is now.

spans.text: But now, I'm starting to understand... She didn't want me to be bound by the past. I want to overcome the past and move forward with Turing as she is now.

units.rawText: Although I can't clearly map our future course, I believe that I have the courage to face it... Are you willing to join us, Professor?
